principle: 身份和画风分开写：identity_prompt 只写长相，style_presets 只写画风。最终提示词 = 风格预设 + 身份提示词 + 表情/场景指令。

style_presets.label: A 纪实档案插画
style_presets.prompt: muted documentary editorial illustration, gouache texture on paper, low saturation, soft flat overcast lighting, restrained palette, subtle paper grain, quiet and observational mood

style_presets.label: B 低饱和平面版画
style_presets.prompt: low saturation flat printmaking style, limited color palette of off-white, ink black, muted red and deep indigo, visible paper texture, slight registration offset, simple shapes, calm composition

style_presets.label: C 克制的高分辨率像素画
style_presets.prompt: high resolution restrained pixel art, limited muted palette, soft dithering, flat lighting, calm documentary mood, clean readable shapes

global_negative: photorealistic celebrity likeness, real person, famous politician, text, watermark, logo, brand name, readable signage, neon, cyberpunk, fantasy, heroic dramatic lighting, lens flare, anime, chibi, exaggerated expression, gore, wounds, hospital bed close-up, children's faces, extra fingers, deformed hands

scene.framing: eye level from behind the desk, leave foreground desk area and midground seat clear
